newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh's leasing company IDLC to offer bonus.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh's leasing company IDLC to offer bonus.

text.p: Industrial Development Leasing Company of Bangladesh Limited (IDLC) may offer one-for-one bonus shares and is likely to pay 35 percent cash dividend for 1996, which ended on December 31, company official said on Saturday.
"We are happy as the company once again has maintained the past growth pattern in 1996," said a company official.
The company paid the same dividend last year against its 100 taka share. It was traded at 2,402 taka at the close of trading on Thursday.
The annual general meeting is set for Sunday.
Listed on both Dhaka and Chittagong Stock Exchanges the company's net profit was 79.91 million taka in the year against 69.42 million taka in 1995, the company officials said.

The value of its lease contracts totalled 900.72 million taka, an increase of about 28 percent over the previous year. "The company continued to maintain sectoral diversity to ensure a balanced portfolio," said the official.
He said the company, which is concentrated in transport, food and chemical sectors, might expand its activity to the real estate sector.
